ca_pothole_dome.blurb: Pothole Dome is a rounded dome at the west end of Tuolumne Meadows in Yosemite's high country, right beside Tioga Road at about 8,700 feet. Nine routes climb its face, nearly all set up as top-ropes with a single trad line. Grades start at beginner-level terrain, sit mostly between 5.5 and 5.10, and top out at one 5.11. The routes are short and low in commitment, which suits newcomers, families and groups wanting easy laps. Hikers also walk up the gentle side of the dome, so there is usually foot traffic around the base.
ca_pothole_dome.parking_note: Leave the car at the roadside turnout on Tioga Road near mile marker 18, then follow the trail alongside the road to the dome.

ca_octagon_south_face_the.blurb: This is the sun-facing side of the big Octagon boulder in Blair Valley, in the desert county east of San Diego. It has nine boulder problems, from VB through V4, with a few each at V0, V3 and V4. Steep lines are the draw here, which is unusual for desert granite. The wall soaks up the sun, so it works on the coldest days and gets hot when the weather is warm. The boulder is a short walk from the roads on either side of the mountain.

ca_power_wall_the.blurb: The Power Wall is the main wall of the Century Lake Area in Malibu Creek State Park, in the Santa Monica Mountains west of Los Angeles. Nine bolted routes are here, eight sport and one top-rope, graded from 5.9 to 5.11 with most of them in the 5.10 range. The lines are short and several share anchors, so only about three parties can work the wall at a time. The rock is volcanic, and the park sits at a low elevation, near 650 feet.

ca_big_columbia_boulder.blurb: Big Columbia is the largest block among the Camp 4 boulders in Yosemite Valley, a roughly 30-foot-tall mass in the woods near Yosemite Lodge that is easy to spot from the campground. It has nine problems: one V0, a middle group from V3 to V5, and a hard top end reaching V10. The problems are tall and committing for a boulder, and the block is a regular stop for climbers working through the Camp 4 circuit.
